fieldValues.title: Work item
fieldValues.theory: A work item names the problem it answers (`Answers: SP-nn`; when none is recorded, suggest the problem first and name it), and sits under a story or epic from the moment it is filed, and is small enough for one session. A bug is not a work item in this sense: bugs need no problem (owner, 2026-10-25: "bugs are bugs"); it carries the bug shape (T5).
fieldValues.practice:
- GitHub issues on the governed repos; stories carry MoSCoW.
- `clerk steward` comments on an issue with no `Answers:` line, and reopens false closes.
- `clerk claim` refuses an issue whose `Answers:` is not an affirmed problem.
- `clerk ground` walks a merged PR to its issue, problem, persona and domain, epic and group, and reports the level reached.
- The analyst files issues in the group's issue shape (`routines/wg-analyst.md`). Board model: [board.md](board.md).
gaps: The link to the problem is a line of text, not a record.
open_questions: Should the problem link become a record or relation? What would it be?
Can a work item answer a problem directly, without an epic?
fieldValues.test: Stage 8: 1 passing; pending: problem link as a record.
